title: Photography Essentials
tagline: See light, master exposure, and make deliberate photographs — phone camera included.
endpoint: from auto mode to deliberate photographs in manual
about: Photography is deliberate seeing — understanding light, controlling exposure, and composing a frame on purpose, with any camera including the one in your pocket. This category walks from how a camera actually works through aperture, shutter, and ISO, to composition, natural light, and developing a personal eye.
